title: Conservative-Space Defection Signal (Economic, Policy-Specific)
statement: Conservative intra-coalition pushback in flagship right-media spaces (Shapiro/Daily Wire comment ecosystems) has become materially more common, sharper, and policy-specific — driven by ECONOMIC grievance (budgets, prices, deficit) rather than personality. Like/laugh reaction ratios function as unscientific but directionally useful telemetry of the engaged loyalist remnant. The defection is internal-opposition formation (defectors retain right-wing argument language, not leftward migration), and ridicule is the emerging sanction because it cannot be attributed to the enemy. Economic policy-specific defection cannot be absorbed by propaganda or personnel changes: finance never lies. This hollowing of the loyalist base feeds the Potemkin thesis: an external war run as theater becomes MORE attractive as internal legitimacy erodes.
evidence_confirmed: Owner's first-person observation: pre-election (lone-voice, few allies, weak counterarguments) vs. post-election 20-month window (frequent, articulate pushback)
Like/laugh ratio inversion on Daily Wire / Shapiro pages — laughter from inside the coalition, unattributable to outgroup
Pushback is policy-specific and economic in character (personal budgets), the category propaganda cannot paper over
Consistent with documented fourth-turning pattern: counter-elite coalitions fracture during crisis phase; regime overreach converts bystanders into internal opposition

2026-09-15: NYT/Siena Hispanic-subsample generic ballot screenshot circulating (Dems +43, trend +8 → +16 → +30 → +43 over 16 months, via MeidasTouch) — unverified single source, magnitude suspect (small subsample n), but slope and channel match the defection mechanism: Hispanics disproportionately exposed to inflation/housing/employment channels where 'finance never lies.' Logged as sentiment telemetry, NOT model input — legacy instrument, measures stated preference under pre-consolidation rules.
[2026-09-17] Beck running oil-scarcity framing contradicting WH minimization; right infosphere now runs same material story the fence suppresses (9/16-17)
evidence_contradicted: Algorithm composition changes post-election (reaction-weighting shifts) could explain part of the VOLUME change — instrumentation, not defection
Left-venturing into right spaces could theoretically explain pushback presence, though it fails against the articulate, right-first-principles character of the arguments observed
falsifier: Signal dies if like/laugh ratios revert toward baseline as algorithms re-tune or the news cycle cools (instrumentation explanation wins), or if pushback reverts to personality-specific rather than policy-specific (absorbable by personnel changes). Signal STRENGTHENS if ratio inversion persists or worsens through the November Pause window and pushes economic — the structural read.
forward_watchlist: Like/laugh ratio trend on flagship right-media pages through November Pause window
Policy-specific vs. personality-specific composition of pushback (economic vs. disgust)
Whether regime responds with economic concessions (absorption) or further consolidation (acceleration)
Interaction with War Question spread: hollowing coalition makes Potemkin posture (loud-but-shallow external war) MORE attractive
Emergence of named internal opposition figures or factions in right-media ecosystems
